production_interpretation: Identity/subject anchor: same subject in time and place changes; matching position/scale is editorial, not facial replacement.
qc_guardrail: Use crop-safe eye-line and subject positioning; no forced same-person claim.

production_interpretation: Motion passes across cut; multi-shot relay extends the idea beyond two shots.
qc_guardrail: Record direction, acceleration, action phase and blur at each boundary.

production_interpretation: Acoustic match, sonic bridge or timbral transformation can work without visual resemblance.
qc_guardrail: Continuity must not falsely imply a character caused a sound.

production_interpretation: Cuts create an association, argument or emotional comparison.
qc_guardrail: Require viewer-legible significance, not a decorative metaphor.

production_interpretation: Match silhouette, frame position, geometry, horizon or direction.
qc_guardrail: Use end/start overlay plus shot-axis and lens QC.

production_interpretation: Multiple independently sourced images or materials share one composited frame.
qc_guardrail: Maintain layer provenance, mask edges, rights and stylistic intention.

production_interpretation: Temporal overlap may express duration, thought or tone shift.
qc_guardrail: Prevent ghost faces and unintended causality during overlaps.

production_interpretation: Panels allow parallel action or change in visual hierarchy; not a traditional single-frame transition.
qc_guardrail: Keep actor faces legible in 9:16 and 16:9 outputs.

production_interpretation: A moving shape, texture or scene is transformed continuously; neural face morph is separately restricted.
qc_guardrail: Lock real start/end plates; do not blend canonical character identity by default.

production_interpretation: Flash, brief brightness change or tonal inversion creates a perceptual interruption.
qc_guardrail: Avoid rapid full-frame flashing and saturated-red flashes; test final-sized render.
